features: 10mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Experience powerful sound with the boAt BassHeads 210 Wired Earphones, equipped with 10mm dynamic drivers that deliver punchy bass with boAt’s Signature Sound. Whether you're deep into a binge-watch session or catching up on podcasts, every beat hits just right.
Built-in Microphone: Answer calls on the move with the in-line mic that makes communication smooth and hands-free, ideal for everything from meetings to quick chats with friends.
Multi-Functional Control Button: Take control of your music and calls using the convenient multi-functional button. Play, pause, or attend calls without missing a moment.
120cm Cable & Universal 3.5mm Jack: Designed with a classic 3.5mm connector, BassHeads 210 ensures easy plug-and-play access with most devices, offering fuss-free usability.
Light Design with Snug Fit: Designed for comfort, the lightweight build and secure in-ear fit make these earphones perfect for long hours of listening, gaming, or streaming.
description: Turn up your audio game with the boAt BassHeads 210 Wired Earphones, where sleek style meets stellar sound. Featuring glossy earlaps that add an edge to your look, these earphones don’t just sound good, they look sharp too. Dive into the world of rich, bass-heavy boAt Signature Sound, powered by dynamic 10mm drivers that make every beat and dialogue come alive, whether you're hooked to a web series or vibing with your favourite podcast. Take calls on the go with the built-in mic that ensures clear, hands-free conversations, be it work or play. Control everything with ease using the multi-functional button. Pause your music or answer calls without reaching for your device. Additionally, you can just press a button to summon Siri or Google Assistant and manage tasks with your voice. Also, the 3.5mm jack offers hassle-free connectivity, while the 120cm cable keeps things stylishly tangle-free. Light in weight and designed for all-day comfort, the BassHeads 210 fits snugly in your ears, making it the perfect companion for long listening sessions, gaming marathons, or daily commutes.
